name: pickup_type_key_table_find_index
description: PickupTypeKeyTable::FindIndex scans pickup logical names and returns the matching pickup table index, or -1 when no logical name matches.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to the Pickup source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja has a known sbb flag-generation limitation in the inlined strcmp mismatch path at 0x41e217; the implementation uses source-level strcmp for the same logical-name comparison.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41e1e0 validates ECX as the requested logical name, scanning g_PickupTypes from index 0 through 39 in 0x30-byte entries, reading logicalName at entry+0x10, skipping null logical names, returning the matching table index, and returning -1 on miss.
The native smoke verifies the first entry, an interior entry after null skipped entries, the last entry, and the missing-name fallback to -1.
